# IInstitutionalVaultRegistryErrors
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/interfaces/IInstitutionalVaultRegistryErrors.sol)

**Title:**
IInstitutionalVaultRegistryErrors

Custom errors for the Institutional Vault Registry


## Errors
### InstitutionAlreadyExists
Reverts when trying to add an institution that already exists


```solidity
error InstitutionAlreadyExists(bytes32 id);
```

### InstitutionNotFound
Reverts when the specified institution cannot be found


```solidity
error InstitutionNotFound(bytes32 id);
```

### InstitutionIsDisabled
Reverts when operating on an institution that has been disabled


```solidity
error InstitutionIsDisabled(bytes32 id);
```

### AddressZero
Reverts when a provided address is zero


```solidity
error AddressZero();
```

### ImmutableFieldUpdateForbidden
Reverts when attempting to update an immutable field for an institution

field is the keccak256("fieldName") for clarity on-chain


```solidity
error ImmutableFieldUpdateForbidden(bytes32 id, bytes32 field);
```

### ReplacementIdConflict
Reverts when replacing an institution and the new id already exists


```solidity
error ReplacementIdConflict(bytes32 newId);
```

### SameAddress
Reverts when attempting to update to the same address


```solidity
error SameAddress();
```
